hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/agent_hooks.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/Project Snip and Crinkle/tools/agent_hooks.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then python3 "$f" selftest --hook || echo "WARNING: agent_hooks selftest crashed: the harness checks may be off"; else echo "WARNING: tools/agent_hooks.py not found: the harness checks are off"; fi
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/agent_hooks.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/Project Snip and Crinkle/tools/agent_hooks.py"; [ -f "$f" ] && python3 "$f" brief || true
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/agent_hooks.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/Project Snip and Crinkle/tools/agent_hooks.py"; [ -f "$f" ] && python3 "$f" lead || true
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/agent_hooks.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/Project Snip and Crinkle/tools/agent_hooks.py"; [ -f "$f" ] && python3 "$f" leadpost || true
